items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: It was done through our manager, Irvin Mills, connection.

ctx.x: Did he choose the band, is that what he wanted or did somebody else come in?

It was done through our manager, Irvin Mills, connection. We played it. We played the first half of his show on stage, just us. No women was in the show. Us and the Barry Brothers, the famous Barry Brothers. That's a trio. No women in the show. We didn't take Ivie with us.

Ivie wasn't with us then, in the Cotton Club, Ethel Waters. No women. In the second part, when he come on, we played in the pit. Man, I remember opening night, Maurice Chevalier, you know, he's a Frenchman didn'tspeak no English at that time. Man, we opened with him, opened up the band and tore them down, then the Barry Brothers come out and tore them down.
